subject.title: RFC 0009: align Hosted Feed v1 specifications

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this RFC’s publisher-first Hosted Feed v1 wire, trust, shard, query, and delta contract as the direction for the linked implementation work?
rationale: The changes define a durable cross-repository protocol and security boundary; source-level review cannot decide the intended permanent compatibility and trust contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the contract direction
options.body: Confirm the RFC as the intended Hosted Feed v1 contract after reviewing redacted interoperability evidence from the linked OpenClaw and ClawHub work.

options.title: Narrow the RFC
options.body: Retain only the currently implementable core and trust requirements, deferring shard, query, delta, or publisher-follow semantics until separately sponsored.

options.title: Pause for implementation feedback
options.body: Wait for the linked implementation PRs to surface concrete protocol constraints before accepting this final-call specification.

recommendation.title: Approve the contract direction
recommendation.body: Confirm the RFC as the intended Hosted Feed v1 contract after reviewing redacted interoperability evidence from the linked OpenClaw and ClawHub work.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the available RFC revision history and is best placed to consolidate requested contract clarifications, although final direction belongs to repository decision-makers.
